note: callout：单条强调/提醒，四种语义色；正文是 content，不是 text。

items.title: 结构错误不会被修
items.content:
缺括号、错括号这类错误直接显示源码与诊断。
行内标记照常解析：`code`、**加粗**、==高亮==。

items.title: Structural errors are never repaired
items.content:
Missing or mismatched brackets show the source and a diagnostic.
Inline markers still work: `code`, **bold**, ==mark==.
